setup: Use DC VOLTS (V DC), black lead in COM and red lead in V/ohms. Programmer disconnected. With battery disconnected, secure the black probe at G (printed GND beside J3). Then power the board from its original battery in its normal operating configuration. Keep it on a nonconductive surface and avoid bridging adjacent pads. Do not use resistance or diode mode while powered.
instructions: Let startup finish and measure the six marked red-probe points P1-P6 at rest, without pressing the button. Keep black on the same GND point G for every reading, including the other two photographs. Report volts; if a reading varies, report its range. Also mention the LED/operating state and whether the PIR is connected. If the board cannot power normally, report that before continuing.

photos.title: 1. Fix black at G; measure VDD, VREF and PIR supply

G.description: Printed GND test hole beside J3. Keep the black probe here for all six readings.

P4.description: Printed VDD test hole beside C2, above U1. Logic supply.

P5.description: Printed VREF test hole, left of Q2. Reference rail.

P6.description: J3 pin 1: rightmost square solder terminal, red PIR supply wire. Not the middle signal terminal.

photos.title: 2. Battery positive at TP14; black stays at G

P1.description: TP14 test hole beside Q1, on the raw BATTERY+ side. Black probe remains at GND from the first photo.

photos.title: 3. Both sides of L1; black stays at G

P2.description: Exposed plated hole immediately above L1 in this photo: VSYS, the post-Q1 supply side. Not TP1.

P3.description: Exposed plated hole immediately below L1, towards C5 positive: RF supply after L1. Not TP2.

expected_use: Compare measured rails, then select receiver, Q1/Q2/Q8 behavior checks. No nominal voltage, successful power-up, or fitted-device identity assumed.
